encode_bboxes_to_tblr: encode ground truth bounding boxes into top bottom left right coordinates relative to prior box centers
decode_tblr_to_bboxes: decode tblr encoded coordinates back to standard xmin ymin xmax ymax bounding box format
create_tblr_bbox_coder: create a TBLRBBoxCoder instance with a custom normalizer factor and border clipping enabled
encode_with_coder: use the TBLRBBoxCoder encode method to transform source bboxes into tblr deltas from ground truth
decode_with_coder: use the TBLRBBoxCoder decode method to apply tblr deltas to prior boxes and get decoded bboxes
